services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Book Now! Enjoy an hour and 45 minute private cruise for up to 6 people aboard a luxury pontoon boat. You will see the beautiful waterways of Venice. Nature lovers will enjoy the dolphins, manatees birds and all the beautiful nature. You’re welcome to bring food and beverage of your choice. What’s Included? Professional licensed captain Private cruise Clean, comfortable pontoon boat Gas BYOB More Info Bring your favorite beverages and food. The trip will be a private cruise up the intercoastal waterway or out in the Gulf depending on the weather. We will see the sunset near the jetties at 2 hr • Up to 6 people

services.name: Midnight Pass Tour
services.desc: Book now! Enjoy a four hour cruise with a licensed captain. Sit back, relax and enjoy the nature. Bring whatever food and drinks you would like. Our captain will find out what exactly you would like to do and customize the trip to you. Our waterways are beautiful and have great places to see stop and enjoy. Restaurant, sand bars, birdwatching, dolphins and manatees. What’s Included? A clean comfortable boat. A licensed captain Pool noodles for swimming More Info You pay for your gas after the trip. Bring a hat and towels. We will discuss an itinerary that you would like to do with the 4 hr • Up to 6 people
